description: Put a person into a match by first name (or by their personal token from an earlier call). Handles waitlists and level ranges; when the level is outside the range, the organizer is asked to approve.

code.description: The 4-character match code from the link, e.g. kicksma.sh/AB12 → AB12.

email.description: Optional. Sends a calendar invite that updates itself.

level.description: Needed once when the match has a level range and the player has no level yet.

token.description: Personal token of an existing player.

name: join_match
title: Join a match
